Apple Maps launched its new "Recommended Places" feature with iOS 26.5, and iOS 27 makes it even more useful.

iOS 27 adds more recommendations to the "Recommended Places" feature in Apple Maps

iOS 26.5 launched in May with two Apple Maps changes, including "Recommended Places." This feature recommends places worth visiting in the Maps search screen.

"Recommended Places" makes recommendations based on popular trends and your recent search history.

The latter is especially important. That is, if you're planning a trip, Maps will detect it and offer relevant suggestions based on the location you're researching.

I think "Recommended Places" is a great addition in iOS 26.5, but there's one thing I'm not satisfied with: it only shows two recommendations at a time.

Fortunately, Apple fixed this issue quickly.

The Maps app in iOS 27 will also display two "Recommended Places" in the search screen, same as before. But now you can swipe horizontally to see more recommendations.

When testing the iOS 27 beta, I saw that it can display up to 10 recommended places at once.

For me, this change is an absolute no-brainer. It makes "Recommended Places" more useful, with absolutely no downsides.

Whether I want to find new local places to try or prepare for future trips, the Maps search screen has quickly become my go-to.

Beyond expanding the "Recommended Places" feature, iOS 27 also includes other improvements to Apple Maps. You can read more here.

Do you use the "Recommended Places" feature in Apple Maps? Will iOS 27 change your habits? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
